_comment: Owner-approved scope exclusions for v0.25.0, read by .github/scripts/check-final-release-gate.sh at tag time. Every entry must stay truthful and must match docs/releases/v0.25.0.md. An entry is only valid once 'approved_by' names the owner who accepted the exclusion and 'approved_at' records the date of that decision; until then the release gate fails closed. Never add an entry for an issue that is still open, and never copy this file forward to a later release: exclusions are version-scoped.

exclusions.reason: No paid LLM provider call was authorized. Provider behaviour is covered by contract, fixture and loopback canary tests only; no provider is claimed as live-verified.

The PKCE login and its security-negative flows pass against a runner-local Keycloak only. No organizational identity tenant was available, so discovery pinning, real JWKS rotation and real claim mapping are unverified.
The Vault KV helper is exercised against a disposable runner-local Vault only. Production HA topology, operational policies, token renewal and outage/failover behaviour are unverified.

The nxs2 Vault Transit envelope-key implementation is on main and covered by deterministic fake-API tests, but no real Transit key has ever encrypted or decrypted a secret. No production Vault Transit, HSM or KMS acceptance is claimed.

Helm lint, render and hardened-posture assertions pass offline in CI. The last live run on 89b608dd failed at termination observation and the script fixes that followed are unvalidated live; no live cluster run exists on the release commit.
The ComfyUI adapter has HTTP/workflow contract fixtures and fail-closed tests only. No real text-to-video model was run and no fixture output is described as video.

A nine-scenario container drill passes on a single Docker host. That is container-isolated-single-host evidence and never multi-host acceptance; multi-host failover and measured RPO/RTO remain unverified.

Repository coverage is met and enforced at the 95.0% gate. A 2 h soak is validated only for the SHAs named in docs/KNOWN_GAPS.md and was not re-run on the v0.25.0 release commit, because workflow_dispatch is not available to the agent identity that prepared this release.
Umbrella blocker. It is closed with this release only because every one of its remaining scopes was completed or explicitly excluded above; the umbrella carries no verification of its own.
